::: {#exr-reverse-sum}
#### The two ends of a reversal

The algorithm `reverse` reverses an array `A[1..n]`, where $n \ge 0$,
by swapping its outermost entries and moving inward:

```text
procedure reverse(A, n)  // A[1..n] is an array, n >= 0
    i := 1
    j := n
    while i < j
        swap A[i] and A[j]
        i := i + 1
        j := j - 1
```

Show that $i + j = n + 1$ is a loop invariant (@def-loop-invariant) of its loop.

:::
